rule.Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.Title: RED THIRST
rule.Text: Each time an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army is selected to fight, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

stratagems.Name: Angelic Grace
stratagems.Category: LIBERATOR ASSAULT GROUP - STRATEGIC PLOY STRATAGEM
stratagems.When: Any phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army has a mortal wound allocated to it.
stratagems.Effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.Name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.Category: LIBERATOR ASSAULT GROUP - BATTLE TACTIC STRATAGEM
stratagems.When: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.Target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.Effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.Name: Savage Echoes
stratagems.Category: LIBERATOR ASSAULT GROUP - BATTLE TACTIC STRATAGEM
stratagems.Target: TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was just charged by an enemy unit.
stratagems.Effect: Select either the Strength or Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead Choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.Name: Red Rampage
stratagems.Category: LIBERATOR ASSAULT GROUP - BATTLE TACTIC STRATAGEM
stratagems.Target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.Effect: Select either the [LANCE] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, then it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities.

stratagems.Name: Aggressive Onslaught
stratagems.Category: LIBERATOR ASSAULT GROUP - STRATEGIC PLOY STRATAGEM
stratagems.When: Your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army has Advanced.
stratagems.Effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge, even though it Advanced. You can instead choose for your unit  to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even  though it Advanced.

stratagems.Name: Relentless Assault
stratagems.Category: LIBERATOR ASSAULT GROUP - STRATEGIC PLOY STRATAGEM
stratagems.When: Your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.Effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge even though it Fell Back. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even thougj it Fell Back.

enhancements.Name: Speed of the Primarch
enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.Name: Rage‑fuelled Warrior
enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s melee weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 3] ability.

enhancements.Name: Icon of the Angel
enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit is selected to Fall Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked, When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

enhancements.Name: Gift of Foresight
enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle round, just after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for the bearer, you can treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

Elle conserve 2 000 points, mais perd une vague de charge aerienne et transforme 230 points de projection en presence de milieu et outil de mission.
groups: Choisir la cible structurante et garder une sortie apres l'echange.

Premiere vague de rupture ou menace qui force l'ecran adverse.
Captain with Jump Pack, Speed of the Primarch et 10 Vanguard Veterans
Menace de contre-charge et paquet qui ne doit pas etre depense avant la bascule centrale.
5 Jump Intercessors, 3 Inceptors et 2 x 5 Scouts
Actions, largeur, ecrans, secondaires et reserve du cinquieme round.
Ouvrir les transports, casser les briques qui empechent les charges utiles.
Home, tir intermediaire et unite qui n'a pas besoin de charger pour contribuer.

scenarioPlans.thesis: Gagner la majorite par vagues : construire deux objectifs solides, puis rendre instable le troisieme objectif adverse.
scenarioPlans.support: Un objectif central-decale avec deux zones de staging, afin que deux vagues Jump ne soient jamais exposees au meme contre-feu.
scenarioPlans.preserve: une vague de charge, une unite rapide de secondaire et au moins deux plateformes antichar
scenarioPlans.first: Installer les Scouts et les lanes; menacer deux charges sans livrer la Death Company avant que l'ecran adverse soit identifie.
scenarioPlans.second: Utiliser la derniere information pour lancer une seule vague utile, puis placer la suivante hors de la reponse directe.
scenarioPlans.lesson: Red Thirst augmente une charge utile; il ne transforme pas une charge sans plan de controle en bonne decision.
rounds: R1 : mesurer les axes, proteger les operateurs et refuser l'exposition simultanee des couches.
R2 : engager une seule ressource offensive et conserver une releve a distance de la reponse adverse.
R3 : remplacer la premiere couche usee, puis choisir si le centre ou un flanc devient la priorite.
R4 : attribuer des maintenant chaque unite survivante au primaire, a une secondaire ou a la bascule finale.
R5 : compter l'OC et les positions legales avant les dommages; la derniere unite mobile ne poursuit pas une cible secondaire.
scenarioPlans.abort: Si operateur, releve et soutien peuvent etre touches par la meme reponse, reduire l'ambition et reconstruire la profondeur.
scenarioPlans.fallback: Tenir deux positions, nettoyer l'unite qui produit le double rendement adverse et reporter l'activation de score plutot que l'annoncer acquise.
scenarioPlans.secondary: Confier la carte a l'unite la moins structurante. Une Scout ou une petite unite mobile porte l'Action laterale; la brique centrale ne quitte le primaire que si les deux objectifs se superposent vraiment.
scenarioPlans.setup: Au debut du round 3 de Battlefield Dominance, l'adversaire peut contester l'objectif cle avec une unite ecran et garde sa piece de contre-attaque en retrait.
scenarioPlans.decision: Envoyer la piece la plus puissante maintenant, ou retirer l'ecran avec une couche secondaire avant de basculer ?
scenarioPlans.a: Si le nettoyage ouvre l'objectif sans exposer la releve, utiliser le tir ou la petite vague, puis conserver la brique principale pour la reprise.
scenarioPlans.b: Si la cible restera contestee ou si le contre-jeu prend deux couches a la fois, tenir la position, ecranter et reporter la bascule.
